name: structifact-validate
description: Run Structifact's own `validate` command against the active file and show the results as VS Code diagnostics.

structifact.cliPath.description: Path to the Structifact CLI executable. You usually don't need to set this: if left unset, the extension automatically checks this workspace's own .venv/ or venv/ folder for a structifact binary before falling back to PATH. Set this explicitly only for an unusual setup (a differently-named or differently-located virtualenv).
